A Heart-Healthy Recipe from the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 minutes Number of Servings: 3 Here's a perfect low-fat thirst quencher. Ingredients 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt 6 medium strawberries 1 cup pineapple, crushed, canned in juice 1 medium banana 1 tsp vanilla extract 4 ice cubes Directions Place all ingredients in blender, and puree until smooth. Serve in frosted glasses.
